name: Amano Aoba
source:
Second youngest sister of Amano family. She calls her brother "Ani". 

A girl who can almost do everything on her own. Due to her father's influence, she always wants to do everything herself without anyone's help, hence her motto "One knife is enough to do almost everything."
She is a serious camper and since she has a motorcycle, her field of options for camping are varied. Like her brother, they have a feeling of "resetting" when they are camping. Her dream is to one day be able to buy a mountain to be able to camp by herself. She likes to use hammocks.

Sexual weakness: Armpit. She gets turned on on the thought that she may smell like sweat.
